card.name: Final piece of drug names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a drug name that was split into parts, such as the endings -ib, -ril, -ol and -ine, in label text. Also fires on the end of a personal name like Harriet.

modes.label: Drug name endings
modes.description: Closing piece of a generic drug name split into several parts, usually right after the name is mentioned in dosing or interaction text.

modes.label: Personal name ending
modes.description: The closing piece of a first name in biographical web text.
modes.example: first wife, Har<<riet>>, was the daughter of the novelist William
